title: Quickflow snapshot set: API onboarding visuals for auth, key rotation, streaming + tool-calls
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Produce a compact, consumable set of onboarding visuals that live in the API/SDK quickstart docs and the first-run canvas. Deliverables: (1) a 6-frame compact flow that explains API key creation -> token rotation -> streaming handshake -> tool-call example, (2) three device-agnostic screenshots (terminal, web snippet, SDK page) optimized for small hero slots, (3) an annotated pullable asset pack (SVG + PNG exports) and a Figma component set so engineers and Docs can reference consistent code snippets and token UI. Design constraints: keep copy to 6 words per step for hero microcards; visuals must work in 320–1440px widths; ensure color usage meets AA contrast for code blocks and callouts. Key trade-offs discussed: using a live terminal gif vs. three static frames — chose static frames for faster page load and simpler localization. Implementation notes: use real endpoint and truncated keys in all screenshots (e.g., rdx_****a3f9) and include a small blur overlay for any customer-identifying telemetry. Linkable artifacts are recorded in comments. This ticket coordinates with ENG-2211 (sample SDK snippet consistency) and PM-4120 (quickstart scope).
